gloss: to reconsider; to think better of; to change one's mind

definitions.gloss: to reconsider; to think again; to think better of
definitions.explanation: To change one's initial decision or opinion after thinking again, often for the better.

examples.japanese: {怒|おこ}って{帰|かえ}ろうとしたが、{思|おも}い{直|なお}した。
examples.english: I was about to leave in anger, but I thought better of it.

examples.japanese: キャンセルしようとしたが、{思|おも}い{直|なお}して{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: I was going to cancel, but I reconsidered and participated.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{言葉|ことば}で{自分|じぶん}の{態度|たいど}を{思|おも}い{直|なお}した。
examples.english: Her words made me reconsider my attitude.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
Pattern: [something]を{思|おも}い{直|なお}す

Can also be used intransitively (without object) to mean 'to reconsider.'

CONJUGATION:
・{思|おも}い{直|なお}さない (negative)
・{思|おも}い{直|なお}して (te-form)
・{思|おも}い{直|なお}した (past)

NUANCE:
Often implies reconsidering a negative decision or action and choosing a better course. Can suggest calming down from an emotional reaction.

COLLOCATIONS:
・{考|かんが}えを{思|おも}い{直|なお}す - to reconsider one's thinking
・{決心|けっしん}を{思|おも}い{直|なお}す - to reconsider one's decision
・もう{一度|いちど}{思|おも}い{直|なお}す - to think again once more

COMPOUND VERB:
{思|おも}う (think) + {直|なお}す (to redo/fix) → to rethink

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{考|かんが}え{直|なお}す - to reconsider (more rational)
・{見直|みなお}す - to review, reconsider
